news.title: Building the Future of Customer Support with MetaMask Activity
news.subtitle: MetaMask's cutting-edge Support tool, winner of an internal hackathon, provides contextual help, education and information to users, and gives Support agents the information they need to assist those users.

childMarkdownRemark.html:
MetaMask's new Support tool, MetaMask Activity.

When I talk to people who aren’t “into crypto”, there’s a clear theme: “It’s really complicated; I don’t understand; there’s so much, I wouldn’t know where to start.”

It’s true, there is a lot of complexity in decentralized ledger technologies. They are a framework through which we can build extremely powerful and fine-tuned collaborative systems, and all that detail and structure is public. Systems this complex exist all around us, and we interact with them every day. But we’re not used to seeing their bones and veins; we’re used to being provided with a simplified version, “the part that concerns us”.

Complexity is one thing; the user experience of something being complicated is a completely different matter. It is incumbent upon those building the interactive tools and experiences of any system to take the complex, and make it make sense.

The process of understanding enough to even interact with public blockchain networks often requires reading arcane, technical texts and absorbing abstract mathematical concepts. With a learning curve this steep, those of us trying to make this technology make sense to users find ourselves in the position of providing education and training as often as actual technical support. As any teacher can tell you, that’s not easy, and it’s not quick.

Let’s take a step back, though: these new technologies offer an incredible opportunity from the perspective of support and privacy. We have, already, a database of all the actions a user has taken on any of their accounts, actions which can be recognized and categorized using software, saving countless hours of manual lookup on the part of the Support agent and the customer.

What’s more, we can have access to this information without the customer ever providing us with their name or their email address; the only thing we need is their public account address.

With this, we can provide live, contextual support for their specific issue while preserving their anonymity. We have no access to, authority or permissions over their accounts; we get only the information we need, and the power stays with the customer. This is the vision we have of the future of customer support which we have begun to build.

A user should not have to sacrifice their privacy simply to have their tech work properly, or to understand how to use it; nor should they sacrifice at the level of user experience. With the tools we have, we can provide contextually-driven information not only on par with traditional infrastructure, but superior to it.

The beginning to all this–the first step in this transformation of the power dynamics between customer and provider–is MetaMask Activity.

All MetaMask Activity needs to work is a public account address, entered either by typing it, copy-pasting it, or authenticating using MetaMask.

The user is then presented with a readout of the transaction history of the account in question. Going much farther than the standard “ledger-style” account readout, the app categorizes the transaction type and provides the user with information specific to the type of transaction they performed.

For example, the common DeFi flow of approving a DEX to have access to your tokens, then swapping with that token:

Or another favorite, minting NFTs:

Notice that failed transaction, showing up in red.

Off the top of my head, it looks like the user smashed that “mint” button twice in a row, and only one transaction went through. But the user doesn’t have to take my word for it; they can click through to the article, or copy-paste the transaction hash (its unique ID) and search for more details on Etherscan:

And yes, ERC-1155 tokens are supported:

…as well as a wide variety of ERC-20 tokens:

MetaMask Activity has an additional tool which helps users chase down transactions that go wrong. Transactions that fail, get stuck, or are pending for long periods of time:

This initial version of MetaMask Activity offers this functionality on Ethereum Mainnet, and it sets the stage for functionality that can be built on top of it: address-authenticated, transaction-specific Support chat; multi-chain analysis; the potential for more advanced features like dapp permissions management and assisted account migration tools.

The idea for MetaMask Activity originated in a conversation between a Help Desk team manager, a product manager on our team, and myself, a technical writer. Our Support agents were spending massive amounts of time helping customers find, and understand how to look at, their own transactions on the blockchain; both the customers and the Support teams desperately needed a tool to help them.

What took this concept to the next level was ConsenSys’ internal hackathon, in the spring of 2022. A team of five volunteered to build it, from all over the world, and all over the company: engineers, a marketer, a project manager, and myself.

Over the course of a work week, we built not only a functional proof of concept of this application, but were able to communicate the ways that it would improve the working conditions of Support agents, reduce the average time to resolution of Support tickets, and empower users to self-solve and learn about this technology. Additionally, it would be a first-of-its-kind application showing the benefits of open blockchain networks for something as normal and day-to-day as customer support.

Our project won that hackathon, and ConsenSys stood by one of its core values of “embracing innovation” by funding the project. A little less than a year later, that same project manager and the team that built the application are delivering this product to MetaMask users.

We hope that MetaMask Activity gives you some insight into what’s going on with your accounts and transactions, and how this technology works. We’re very much focused on the long-term potential of this product, and remember: if you get stuck, we’re only a few clicks away.

Try it out here: activity.metmask.io

nodes.title: How to bridge tokens
nodes.subtitle: Easily move your crypto across chains.

image.title: How to bridge crypto with MetaMask
image.description: How to bridge crypto with MetaMask wallet

childMarkdownRemark.html:
You know the drill. You’ve got 200 in ETH on Ethereum, and you want to bridge it to USDC on Linea. In lesser hands, this process could be clunky and time consuming. With MetaMask wallet, bridging tokens is as easy as can be.

Our aggregator finds you fast, cost-effective routes to move your tokens from one chain to another. And with cross-chain swapping, bridging and swapping can take place at the same time in a single transaction. Meaning: you can swap a token from one chain to a different token on another chain all in one move. Bada-bing, bada-boom.

Below, you’ll find step-by-step guides showing you how to bridge crypto with MetaMask on desktop and mobile app.

Let’s get into it! 🦊

How to bridge crypto with MetaMask Extension

  1. Click Bridge to get started
  2. Select the network and token you want to bridge from. Example: ETH on Ethereum.
  3. Select the network and token you want to bridge to. Example: USDC on Linea.
  4. Enter the amount you want to send to load quotes. Example: 0.1 ETH
  5. Select the recommended qoute presented to you, or select another option by clicking on View all quotes.
  6. Click Brigden to confirm your bridge transaction in your MetaMask wallet.
  7. Your transaction will be submitted and confirmed shortly after. You’ll be able to view your assets on the new chain.

Success! 🦊

How to bridge crypto with MetaMask App

  1. Sign-in to your MetaMask App.
  2. Tap the menu button, which has two arrows in opposite directions and is located on the bottom of your homepage screen.
  3. Tap Bridge. Note: You will be taken to the Bridge feature on MetaMask Portfolio.
  4. Select the network you want to bridge from. Example: Ethereum.
  5. Select the token you want to bridge and enter the amount you want to send. Example: 0.1 ETH.
  6. Select the network you want to bridge your tokens to. Example: Linea.
  7. Select the token you want to receive on your destination network. Example: USDC
  8. Select the recommended route presented to you, or select another option by clicking on Choose a different quote.
  9. Click Confirm to confirm your bridge transaction in your MetaMask wallet.
  10. You’ll be able to keep track of your transfer with the Bridging in progress bar, and view your assets on the new chain.

Success! 🦊

Ready to get started? If you’re on desktop, download MetaMask Extension. If you’re on mobile, download MetaMask App for iOS or Android.

Need more help? We got you. Check out our MetaMask Support guide for detailed info about bridging crypto.

image.title: How to swap crypto
image.description: How to swap crypto with MetaMask

childMarkdownRemark.html:
Swapping crypto is fast, easy, and secure with MetaMask. You can choose from thousands of your favorite tokens across nine networks including Ethereum, Linea, Base, and Arbitrum. MetaMask Swaps also include gas fees right in your quotes, making swapping crypto as smooth as can be.

We've simplified cross-chain swapping too. Send&Swap lets you choose the token you want to spend and the token you want the other person to receive — all in one move. As ever, safety is essential when it comes to your digital assets. So rest easy. MetaMask Swaps are powered by our razor-tight, industry-leading security.

Below, you'll find step-by-step guides showing you how to swap crypto with MetaMask.

Let’s get into it! 🦊

How to swap crypto with MetaMask Extension

  1. Open the MetaMask browser extension.
  2. Select the network you want to swap on, and click the Swap button.
  3. Select the token you want to swap from. Example: ETH.
  4. Enter the amount that you want to swap.
  5. Select the token you want to swap to. Example: DAI.
  6. A preferred quote will be loaded automatically. To select a different quote, click View all quotes.
  7. Click Swap to confirm.

Success! 🦊

How to swap crypto with MetaMask App

  1. Sign-in to your MetaMask mobile app.
  2. Select the network you want to swap on, located at the top of your screen. Example: Ethereum Mainnet.
  3. Tap the menu button, which has two arrows in opposite directions and is located on the bottom of your homepage screen.
  4. Tap Swap.
  5. Select the token you want to swap from by tapping the token name that appears under your wallet address. Example: ETH.
  6. Enter the amount that you want to swap.
  7. Select the token you want to swap to. Example: DAI.
  8. Tap Get quotes to proceed. Note: you can manually select a different quote from our range of industry-leading providers.
  9. Tap Swap to confirm.

Success! 🦊

How to swap crypto with MetaMask Portfolio

  1. Connect your MetaMask wallet to portfolio.metamask.io
  2. Click Move crypto.
  3. Click Swap.
  4. Select the network you want to swap from in the dropdown menu. Example: Ethereum.
  5. Select the token you want to swap from. Example: ETH.
  6. Enter the amount that you want to swap.
  7. Select the token you want to swap to. Example: DAI.
  8. Click Get Quotes to proceed. Note: you can manually select a different quote from our range of industry-leading providers.
  9. Click Swap to confirm.

Success! 🦊

Ready to start swapping crypto? If you’re on desktop, download MetaMask Extension. If you’re on mobile, download MetaMask app for iOS or Android.

Need more help? We got you. Check out our MetaMask Support guide about swapping crypto.

image.title: How to sell crypto
image.description: How to sell crypto with MetaMask

childMarkdownRemark.html:
Selling crypto for cash is as simple as can be with MetaMask. You can exchange crypto from MetaMask wallet directly to your debit card, credit card, PayPal, or bank account. No unnecessary steps, no excess fees, no worries.

We know that safety is essential when it comes to your digital assets, and MetaMask is the most secure crypto wallet for good reason. Our security is industry-leading and razor-tight, so you can sell (and buy, swap, stake, and bridge) with peace of mind. And if you need help along the way, our 24/7 support team is always here to assist around-the-clock.

Below, you'll find videos and step-by-step guides showing you how to sell crypto with MetaMask on your browser or mobile app.

Let's get into it! 🦊

How to sell crypto with MetaMask Extension

Click the Buy & Sell button on MetaMask extension to redirect to MetaMask Portfolio. Once there, connect your MetaMask wallet.

  1. Click Move crypto.
  2. Click Sell.
  3. Select your region, and currency — located to the right of your wallet address.
  4. Enter the amount of crypto that you want to sell. Example: 0.5 ETH.
  5. Select the account destination you want. Example: debit card, credit card, bank account, or PayPal balance. Availability will depend on your region.
  6. Select the best real-time quote from our industry-leading providers. You'll be securely redirected to the provider’s website where you may have to share KYC, then directed back to MetaMask Portfolio once you accept the quote.
  7. After returning to MetaMask Portfolio, click Send ETH.
  8. Click Confirm to complete the transaction in your MetaMask wallet.

Note: You can click on Sell to keep track of your order as it is processed. Times may vary depending on provider.

Success! 🦊

How to sell crypto with MetaMask app

  1. Sign-in to your MetaMask app.
  2. Tap on the menu button‚ which has two arrows in opposite directions and is located on the bottom of your homepage screen.
  3. Tap Sell.
  4. Select your region and currency — located to the right of your wallet address.
  5. Enter the crypto amount you want to sell. Example: 0.5 ETH.
  6. Tap Send your cash to and select the account destination you want. Example: debit card, credit card, bank account, or PayPal. Availability will depend on your region.
  7. Tap Get quotes to proceed.
  8. Select the best quote from our industry-leading providers. You'll be securely redirected to the provider’s portal, where you may have to share KYC, then directed back to MetaMask app once you accept the quote.
  9. Review the order summary in your MetaMask app, and tap Confirm to complete the transaction.

Note: You can tap on progress notification to keep track of your order as it is processed. Times may vary depending on provider.

Success! 🦊

Ready to get started? If you’re on desktop, download MetaMask Extension. If you’re on mobile, download MetaMask App in the Apple Store or Google Store.

**Need more help? We got you. Check out MetaMask Support's how to sell crypto guide.
